com.wms.spartacus.Rules.Feature: WILD is wild for all symbols except FEATURE.
com.wms.spartacus.Help.FeatureExplanatio: FEATURE only appears on reels 1,3 and 5 of the MAIN REEL SET and reels 1,3 and 5 of the COLOSSAL REEL SET.
com.wms.spartacus.Help.RandomReplacement: Each reel contains a number of adjacent positions that, before the reel spin initiates, are randomly replaced with a symbol from the paytable except FEATURE.
com.wms.framework.Paytable.HighestWinner: Only highest winner paid per winning combination on each reel set.
com.wms.framework.Paytable.LeftmostAdjac: Line pays must occur on adjacent reels, beginning with the leftmost reel on each reel set.
com.wms.spartacus.Help.OneReelSetToNext: Line pays do not continue from one reel set to the next.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.FreeSpin.Trigger: 3 or more scattered FEATURE across both reel sets trigger the Free Spin Feature.
com.wms.spartacus.Help.5ScatterFeature: 5 or more scattered FEATURE symbols award 20 free spins + 20x Total Bet.
com.wms.spartacus.Help.4ScatterFeature: 4 scattered FEATURE symbols award 12 free spins + 5x Total Bet.
com.wms.spartacus.Help.3ScatterFeature: 3 scattered FEATURE symbols award 8 free spins + 2x Total Bet.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.Freespin.Alterna: During free spins, an alternate set of reels is used for each reel set.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.Freespin.SameBet: The bet per line and the active paylines remain the same as the spin that triggered the feature.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.Freespin.Alterna: Winning combinations for these reels are identical to the base game.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.Feature.ScatterP: Scatter pays are multiplied by the total bet.
Scatter pays are added to payline wins.
com.wms.framework.Paytable.FollowingLine: The following lines can contribute to wins.
com.wms.spartacus.Paytable.WinOccursOnAl: A win can occur in any or all of these lines.
com.wms.framework.Paytable.PaylinesAdded: Wins on multiple paylines are added together.
com.wms.framework.Paytable.TotalBetDivid: Total line bet must be divided equally between each active payline; therefore, all total bet amounts are not available.
com.wms.spartacus.Help.LineBetAmount: The total bet is the line bet amount added for every 2 lines.
com.wms.framework.Paytable.ActivePayline: Only active paylines can register wins.
com.wms.framework.WinCap.ScreenMessage: You've won the Highest Award for this game!
com.wms.framework.WinCap.MaxAmountAchiev: Maximum win amount has been achieved - {0}!
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.Malfunction: Malfunction voids all pays and plays.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.MaxWin: A win cannot exceed ||AMOUNT|| per wager
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.SymbolTransfer: Any four stacked WILD appearing on the MAIN REEL SET start a symbol transfer, turning the corresponding reel on the COLOSSAL REEL SET into WILD.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.PaysEvaluation: All pays are evaluated after WILD transfers.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.AlternateReelSet: Each reel set uses an alternate set of reels.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.FreeSpin.WildExp: During the free spins, WILD is wild for all symbols except FEATURE.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.FreeSpin.StackNu: If one or more WILD from a stack appears on a reel of the Main Reel Set, the rest of the stack will nudge into place, making all four reel positions on the reel WILD.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.FreeSpin.WildTra: The WILD will then transfer over to the COLOSSAL REEL SET, making the corresponding reel WILD.
com.wms.spartacus.Rules.FreeSpin.Additio: During free spins, 3 or more scattered FEATURE across both reel sets adds additional free spins to the amount of free spins remaining
